entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/ad
entities.reasoning: Pods of the ad deployment repeatedly entered BackOff, preventing the ad service from serving requests.
entities.evidence: Kubernetes events show 46 BackOff for pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5; alert RequestErrorRate on frontend-proxy spikes.

entities.name: otel-demo/Pod/ad-554b849958-l9ft5
entities.reasoning: This pod is the failing instance of the ad deployment causing the service outage.
entities.evidence: BackOff event count 46 for this pod (k8s_events_raw.tsv).

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/ad
entities.reasoning: Service could not route traffic because its backing pods were in BackOff.
entities.evidence: Deployment failure propagated to service endpoints.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend-proxy
entities.reasoning: Observed warning RequestErrorRate due to downstream ad-service failures causing proxy errors.
entities.evidence: Alert RequestErrorRate (warning) firing for frontend-proxy at 2025-12-15T17:39:55Z.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend receives errors from proxy, leading to degraded user experience.
entities.evidence: Propagation chain from ad failure to frontend via proxy; no direct alerts but implied impact.
